behavior: AC1: with both vault hooks installed and pre-commit-managed, checkVaultHooks PASSES and performs no mutation.
AC2: gate missing and --fix not set -> FAIL with remediation, no install attempted.

AC3: under --fix with pre-commit available, both hooks are installed via `pre-commit install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-push` in the vault; idempotent on re-run; an install failure is reported.
AC4: under --fix with the vault present but pre-commit absent -> loud FAIL, never a silent skip.
AC5: no vault checkout at the resolved path -> SKIP (non-fatal).
AC6: the vault path is resolved via the VAULT_PATH seam (no hardcode); the whole check suite drives behavior through injected VAULT_PATH.
